projectInfo.name: DMS Auth Contract
projectInfo.author: DMS Provider Bridge contributors
projectInfo.description: Generic Auth contract used to resolve credentials, tokens and upstream authentication schemes.

config.json._comment: Auth contract template. Driver and connection configs reference this contract through credentials/auth sections.

_comment: Auth is a separate bridge layer. TC VFS Contract defines operation shapes, Driver defines DMS behavior, Connection defines the mount, Auth defines how identity is resolved and applied.
